ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ النَّاهِيْ عَنِ التَّبْذِيْرِ وَالْإِسْرَافِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Al-Nāhī `ani ‘t-tabdhīri wa ‘l-isrāf.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family prohibitor of wastefulness and extravagance!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الْبَحْرِ الْخِضَمِّ الَّذِيْ مِنْهُ الْاِغْتِرَافِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Al-Baḥri ‘l-khiḍammi ‘lladhī minhu ‘l-ightirāf.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the vast sea from which is sipped!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَسْعِفْنَا بِهِ كُلَّ الْإِسْعَافِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa as`ifnā bi hī kulla ‘l-is`āf.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and relieve us by him every relief!
